text: I step out of the crush and read the notice board from top to bottom—the new taxes, the curfew, and the warning about the missing patrol.
motivation: The board is posted right at the choke point with rules and a patrol warning I can use before I deal with the guards.
intended: I want the posted rules and whatever the patrol notice actually says so I know what the gate will enforce.

text: I walk up to the gate serjeant and ask what a lone traveler owes to pass, and whether the missing patrol changes who gets through.
motivation: He is standing by the board with a roster, and the patrol warning is what has the gate on edge.
intended: I want the toll for one person and a straight answer on whether I can enter now.

text: I step up to the gate and tell the serjeant I'll take the standard toll and examination now.
motivation: He said a lone traveler still passes by presenting for the usual toll and check, and the missing patrol does not change that.
intended: I want to get through the gate under the closer scrutiny instead of waiting on the patrol.

text: I face the guard, give my name as Galinor, a traveling wizard with no goods to declare, and wait for them to name the toll and begin the check.
motivation: The serjeant already sent this guard to process me, and the captain is watching the procedure.
intended: I want the toll stated and the examination finished so I can pass the gate.

text: I set my pack open for the guard and ask the exact coin of that modest fee so I can pay it while they look.
motivation: The guard is already moving in to inspect me, and the serjeant has named a modest fee for a traveler with nothing to declare.
intended: I want the pack checked and the toll paid so the gate lets me through.

text: I count out three silver and hand them to the serjeant, then stand clear so the guard can finish inspecting the open pack.
motivation: They named three silver upfront, and the guard is waiting on that payment before the check goes on.
intended: I want the toll settled so the inspection can finish and I can pass.

text: I keep my hands in sight and let the guard finish the pack, then ask if I'm clear to go through.
motivation: The toll is paid and the guard is already going through the open pack.
intended: I want the inspection closed and a clear yes to pass the gate.

text: I close my pack, thank them, and walk through the gate onto the main road.
motivation: The guard said I'm clear to pass if I keep to the main road and stay inside curfew.
intended: I want to be inside Cinderwatch before the line snarls again.

text: I stay on the main road and ask the first local I pass where a traveler can get a bed and a meal before curfew.
motivation: I'm inside the gate district with the curfew still in force, and the town is ahead of me.
intended: I want a named place to sleep tonight so I'm off the street before dusk.

text: I follow the weathered sign down the main road and go into the Rusty Tankard.
motivation: The runner pointed me to the Rusty Tankard for a bed and a hot meal, and said to be inside before sundown.
intended: I want a bed and a meal booked before the curfew shuts the district.
